# Anivora 0.1.45

- Enable the Telegram group link in the profile; unfinished Instagram and Reddit buttons remain disabled.

- Correct portrait player safe areas, loading position and landscape fullscreen behavior.
- Add persisted Fit, Fill and Stretch, clearer playback controls and landscape episode navigation.
- Preserve measured progress across embedded playback, mini-player and Cast handoff; route TV controls to the receiver.
- Separate new external Anime/Manga folders while preserving existing downloads and interrupted jobs.
- Repair Android comment composition, subtree deletion, pagination, counts and cached reply ancestry.
- Distinguish offline/unknown connectivity from confirmed service outages.
- Add secure owner-managed announcements and durable reconnect synchronization with a silent indicator.
- Restore Home mode, remove cached-content banners, fix explicit Search history and skeleton states, and preserve trailer proportions.
- Remove app-owned menu dimming while retaining dark panels and Android-owned permission dialogs.

Package name, signing identity, preferences, downloads, histories, accounts and existing provider configuration are preserved. Provider restoration remains on hold. Physical Infinix Hot 50i/XOS and actual Cast-receiver playback require device verification; controlled media tests do not establish real-provider availability or spoken language.
